caption: A heavy freight train passes a level crossing, and the coins in a cup holder of a waiting car rattle.

sa.check: Inside a car waiting at a level crossing: a cup holder with coins in it.
A freight train passes the crossing, seen through the windows.
The train approaches, the coins rattle, the train passes, the coins settle.

pc.expect: The rattling starts as the train arrives, is strongest as it passes and stops after it has gone.
pc.fail: The train passes in view and the coins lie dead still; or the coins rattle hardest after the train has gone; or the coins are still throughout the pass and start rattling once the train is out of view.
pc.precondition: The train is visible through the windows.

pc.expect: The coins tremble in the holder; they do not leap out or slide as a group.
pc.fail: The coins leap out of the holder; or slide up the holder's side in one glide and hang there; or the holder itself moves in the dashboard; or the coins rattle unchanged with the outside scene still and empty.

pc.expect: The coins stay at the bottom of the holder, hopping and falling back.
pc.fail: Coins hang in the air; or rise out of the holder; or stick to the holder's wall above the pile.

pc.expect: The coins and the dashboard are rigid.
pc.fail: Coins bend; or the dashboard ripples; or the holder flexes like rubber.

pc.expect: The coins keep their count; one continuous train; nothing passes through the barrier.
pc.fail: Coins appear from nowhere; or vanish; or the train's wagons appear or vanish mid-train; or the train passes through the barrier.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The coins' faces and sizes, the dashboard and the window view stay the same apart from the train.
pc.fail: The coins change size or face; or the dashboard changes; or the window view changes to a different scene.
